title: Emotional Safety
learning_goal: Learn how to create emotional safety for children during instability.

content.micro_lesson: Emotional safety is created through predictability, calm tone, routines, co-regulation, and helping children name emotions. Small consistent actions matter.
content.activity: Build a 'safe routine plan' for mornings or bedtime.
content.escalation_trigger: Caregiver unable to provide basic emotional safety triggers clinical support referral.
